equivalent.N06: SetCursorAction(ViewportStartIndex) -> SetCursorAction(0). The reducer (ViewportReducer.CursorOnlyJump) computes Math.Clamp(target, state.ViewportStartIndex, rightLimit); ViewportStartIndex >= 0, so a target of 0 and a target of ViewportStartIndex clamp to the same bar (or throw identically if the range were inverted). No state, speech or earcon can differ. Excluded from the denominator.
